name: Think Tank
context: Local knowledge graph + tasks + Exa trace store used by the assistant runtime.

name: Think Tank: Memory Path
context: Absolute path for persisted memory store, synced from system_config logs.

name: Exa API
context: External search/answer provider; requests logged for traceability and reuse.

name: Exa Web Search Request
context: Structured record of a search(query, num_results, type, category, live_crawl) and response metadata.

name: Exa Answer Request
context: Structured record of an answer(question, max_citations) and returned citations/snippets.

name: Activity Log
context: Append-only audit log of think/exa_search/exa_answer/system_config events with status and request/response blobs.

name: Observation
context: Atomic fact/memory attached to an entity; soft-deleted when entity is deleted to avoid resurfacing.

name: Relation
context: Directed edge between entities; unique on (from,to,relationType) while active; cascades on entity delete.

name: Task
context: Lightweight task system synced to the graph; lifecycle todo→in_progress→completed; priority 1..5.

name: Think Session
context: Structured “thinking” run; always logged; optionally persisted to memory as an observation.

name: Entity Upsert Pipeline
context: Implements upsert_entities semantics: create when absent; update when flagged; replace observations on update.

name: Graph Read API
context: read_graph/open_nodes/search_nodes: returns only active entities/observations/relations; deleted omitted.

name: Memory Query API
context: Filters active observations joined to active entities; supports keyword, time window, tag, agent; capped limit.

name: Rate Limit Guard
context: Protects Exa endpoints; records 429 outcomes in activity logs; backs off and retries selectively.

name: Cascading Soft Delete
context: On delete_entities, soft-deletes dependent observations and relations for audit while excluding from reads.

name: Think Log (Entity)
context: Dedicated entity used to store persisted think traces when storeInMemory=true.

name: Legacy Exa Key Rotation
context: Runbook for rotating Exa keys; includes handling expired keys and updating env + config logs.

name: Archived Sandbox Graph
context: Old scratch knowledge graph used during early prototyping; kept for audit but excluded from reads.
